# LiveChain Completes Acquisition of MIT-Originated Humanyze Assets, Positioning it for the Next Frontier of Enterprise AI


November 24, 2026 8:00am EST


*Majority-owned by Vyome, LiveChain builds on technology originating from MIT research to pursue the future of organizational intelligence in an agentic world*


CAMBRIDGE, Mass. & PRINCETON, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Vyome Holdings, Inc. (“Vyome”) (NASDAQ: HIND) and LiveChain, Inc. (OTC: LICH) (“LiveChain”), its indirect majority-owned subsidiary, today jointly announced the completion of the acquisition by LiveChain of substantially all of the assets of Sociometric Solutions, Inc., doing business as Humanyze. The acquired assets principally comprise intellectual property and technology associated with Humanyze’s enterprise workforce intelligence software business. LiveChain intends to operate under the Humanyze brand name, subject to any required corporate and regulatory approvals.


Founded on research emerging from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Media Lab, Humanyze developed technology designed to help organizations understand how people collaborate, communicate, and work together. Its approach combines organizational network analysis, behavioral data, and advanced analytics to reveal patterns of organizational effectiveness.


As enterprises increasingly deploy AI agents alongside human employees, LiveChain believes a new opportunity is emerging: understanding, measuring, and optimizing how humans and intelligent agents work together. Humanyze’s MIT-originated technology provides a foundation from which to explore this opportunity.


**From MIT Research to the Future of Enterprise AI**


Humanyze’s origins at MIT reflect a fundamental insight: understanding how people interact and collaborate can be as important to organizational performance as understanding financial and operational metrics.


Historically, enterprise software has focused on tracking transactions, managing resources, and measuring lagging outcomes. Humanyze’s technology was developed to help organizations understand the underlying patterns of collaboration and communication that influence those outcomes, thereby creating leading indicators.


In a predominantly analog workplace, capturing and analyzing organizational interactions required specialized infrastructure and complex data collection. The emergence of AI agents creates a fundamentally different environment: increasingly, organizational work and collaboration will occur digitally, creating new opportunities to understand how humans and intelligent agents work together.


The first wave of enterprise AI has focused on making individuals more productive. LiveChain believes the next wave will focus on making entire organizations more intelligent.


“The enterprise of the future will not be made up of humans alone or AI agents alone. It will be a collaboration between the two,” said Krishna Gupta, Chairman of LiveChain. “Humanyze was born out of MIT research to understand how humans work together. We believe its next chapter could be about understanding how humans and AI agents work together. That is an extraordinary opportunity, and one we believe is only beginning to emerge.”


By combining Humanyze’s research-driven foundation with emerging AI capabilities, LiveChain intends to explore the development of intelligent systems that can help enterprises identify inefficiencies, anticipate organizational challenges, optimize collaboration, and ultimately improve how work gets done.


“Vyome remains focused on advancing its immuno-inflammatory and rare-disease programs, while also seeking to derive value from its existing holdings,” said Venkat Nelabhotla, Chief Executive Officer of Vyome. “The completion of this transaction gives LiveChain a foundation and the flexibility to evaluate partnerships, capital formation and selective M&A as the opportunity evolves.”


**A Platform for Long-Term Value Creation**


LiveChain views the acquisition as a foundational step in establishing a differentiated position in the emerging enterprise intelligence market. LiveChain intends to leverage Humanyze’s existing intellectual property, analytical capabilities, and organizational intelligence expertise to explore the development of AI-powered solutions.


LiveChain believes that enterprises will increasingly seek technologies capable of understanding not only what is happening across their organizations, but why it is happening and how performance can be improved.


LiveChain intends to evaluate strategic partnerships, complementary technologies, and additional growth opportunities as it advances this vision.


**Transaction Overview**


The acquisition closed on November 19, 2026, through a previously disclosed equity-based transaction involving LiveChain, its wholly owned subsidiary LICH AI, Inc., and Remus Capital. Under the transaction, Remus transferred senior secured convertible notes issued by Sociometric Solutions, Inc., with an aggregate principal amount of approximately $5.765 million, to LICH AI in exchange for 211,200,844 shares of LiveChain common stock, representing 25% of LiveChain’s outstanding common stock on a fully diluted basis immediately following closing.


LICH AI subsequently acquired Humanyze’s enterprise workforce intelligence software business assets in satisfaction of the notes, which were extinguished. The asset transfer did not require a cash purchase price. LICH AI assumed certain specified historical customer contracts relating to transferred assets and contracts, while other pre-closing liabilities remained with Sociometric Solutions.


Following completion, Vyome retains an indirect majority ownership interest in LiveChain.


The transaction involved related parties, including Remus-affiliated directors of Vyome. Additional details regarding the transaction, equity consideration, related-party relationships, and transaction governance will be disclosed in Vyome’s subsequent filings with the SEC.


**About LiveChain**


LiveChain, Inc. (OTC: LICH) is an emerging artificial intelligence company focused on the future of enterprise intelligence. Indirectly majority-owned by Vyome Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: HIND), LiveChain is building upon technology originating from MIT research to pursue the development of AI-powered solutions that enable organizations to understand, optimize, and transform how they operate.
